records.name: Künstlerin Begründungsreif
records.biography_en: Has completed the work and is still accepting explanations of why it matters. Her HyperNorm board offers an object already surrounded by explanations. A dissonant card asks whether looking first is still permitted. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Werk ist fertig. Seine Begründung wird weiter entgegengenommen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has completed the work and is still accepting explanations of why it matters.

records.name: Kritiker Kennerspur
records.biography_en: Can recognize importance before the object has had a chance to interfere. His HyperNorm monocle recognizes importance before the catalogue introduces the object. A dissonant card asks what he actually saw before knowing what to say. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bedeutung wurde vor dem Sichtkontakt fachgerecht erkannt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can recognize importance before the object has had a chance to interfere.

records.name: Wachwart Ruhebestand
records.biography_en: Keeps an eye on everything and would like permission to decide which eye. His HyperNorm counter records the visitors passing through an approved silence. A dissonant card asks whether a tired guard is part of the collection too. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aufsicht erfolgt wechselweise mit dem verfügbaren Auge.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps an eye on everything and would like permission to decide which eye.

records.name: Malerin Fleckwirkung
records.biography_en: Insists the accident was intentional once everybody has admired it. Her HyperNorm palette makes each accident available for retrospective intention. A dissonant card enjoys a mark she had planned to hide. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Absicht wird nach Würdigung des Flecks festgelegt.

variant_notes.note_en: Insists the accident was intentional once everybody has admired it.

records.name: Skulptor Eigenform
records.biography_en: Has become the exhibit and still objects to the lighting. His HyperNorm loop sculpture insists the room is framing him incorrectly. A dissonant card asks whether being unfinished might be a useful form. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Eigenform beanstandet weiterhin die äußeren Bedingungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has become the exhibit and still objects to the lighting.

records.name: Shopwart Andenklich
records.biography_en: Can offer a portable version of the experience nobody has yet agreed happened. His HyperNorm tote promises a portable version of an unsettled experience. A dissonant card asks whether a memory must fit the souvenir. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Erlebnis ist in zwei handlichen Ausführungen erhältlich.

variant_notes.note_en: Can offer a portable version of the experience nobody has yet agreed happened.
